ayahs.tr: Ya, Seen.

ayahs.ar: وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيْمِ ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: By the wise Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۝٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

ayahs.ar: عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ۝٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: On a straight path.

ayahs.ar: تَنْزِيْلَ الْعَزِيْزِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۝٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.ar: لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا͏ٓ اُنْذِرَ اٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُهُمْ فَهُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ ۝٦
ayahs.tr: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلٰٓي اَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝٧
ayahs.tr: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِيْٓ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ اَغْلٰلًا فَهِيَ اِلَي الْاَذْقَانِ فَهُمْ مُّقْمَحُوْنَ ۝٨
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ سَدًّا وَّمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَاَغْشَيْنٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ ۝٩
ayahs.tr: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

ayahs.ar: وَسَوَا࢜ءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَاَنْذَرْتَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَّاَجْرٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۝١١
ayahs.tr: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰي وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوْا وَاٰثَارَهُمْؕؔ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ اَحْصَيْنٰهُ فِيْٓ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝١٢ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

ayahs.ar: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلًا اَصْحٰبَ الْقَرْيَةِۘ اِذْ جَا࢜ءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝١٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

ayahs.ar: اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّا͏ٓ اِلَيْكُمْ مُّرْسَلُوْنَ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا مَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَاۙ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مِنْ شَيْءٍۙ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا تَكْذِبُوْنَ ۝١٥
ayahs.tr: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْۚ لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهُوْا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا طَا࢜ىِٕرُكُمْ مَّعَكُمْؕ اَىِٕنْ ذُكِّرْتُمْؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُوْنَ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

ayahs.ar: وَجَا࢜ءَ مِنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِيْنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسْعٰي قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۝٢٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

ayahs.ar: اتَّبِعُوْا مَنْ لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ اَجْرًا وَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لِيَ لَا͏ٓ اَعْبُدُ الَّذِيْ فَطَرَنِيْ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

ayahs.ar: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اٰلِهَةً اِنْ يُّرِدْنِ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّيْ شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا يُنْقِذُوْنِ ۝٢٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيْٓ اِذًا لَّفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيْٓ اٰمَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُوْنِ ۝٢٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

ayahs.ar: قِيْلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَؕ قَالَ يٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِيْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٢٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

ayahs.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِيْ رَبِّيْ وَجَعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِيْنَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلٰي قَوْمِهٖ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ مِنْ جُنْدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنْزِلِيْنَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

ayahs.ar: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ خٰمِدُوْنَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

ayahs.ar: يٰحَسْرَةً عَلَي الْعِبَادِۚؔ مَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.tr: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۝٣١ؕ
ayahs.tr: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيْعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ ۝٣٢ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْاَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُۚۖ اَحْيَيْنٰهَا وَاَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَاْكُلُوْنَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.tr: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَّاَعْنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرْنَا فِيْهَا مِنَ الْعُيُوْنِ ۝٣٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

ayahs.ar: لِيَاْكُلُوْا مِنْ ثَمَرِهٖۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ اَيْدِيْهِمْؕ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.ar: سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢ͏ْبِتُ الْاَرْضُ وَمِنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.tr: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيْلُۚۖ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمْ مُّظْلِمُوْنَ ۝٣٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

ayahs.ar: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِيْ لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَاؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ ۝٣٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰي عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِيْمِ ۝٣٩
ayahs.tr: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

ayahs.ar: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنۢ͏ْبَغِيْ لَهَا͏ٓ اَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيْ فَلَكٍ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.tr: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ ۝٤١ۙ
ayahs.tr: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مِّثْلِهٖ مَا يَرْكَبُوْنَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.tr: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ نَّشَاْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيْخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْقَذُوْنَ ۝٤٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰي حِيْنٍ ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْا مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.tr: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ مِّنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.tr: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُۙ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَّوْ يَشَا࢜ءُ اللّٰهُ اَطْعَمَهٗٓࣗۖ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.tr: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: مَا يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُوْنَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.tr: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ تَوْصِيَةً وَّلَا͏ٓ اِلٰٓي اَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۝٥٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوْرِ فَاِذَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُوْنَ ۝٥١
ayahs.tr: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا يٰوَيْلَنَا مَنْۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَّرْقَدِنَاۘࣝؔ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.tr: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

ayahs.ar: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ جَمِيْعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.tr: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

ayahs.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.tr: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِيْ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوْنَ ۝٥٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

ayahs.ar: هُمْ وَاَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِيْ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَي الْاَرَا࢜ىِٕكِ مُتَّكِـُٔوْنَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.tr: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمْ فِيْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمْ مَّا يَدَّعُوْنَ ۝٥٧ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

ayahs.ar: سَلٰمٌࣞ قَوْلًا مِّنْ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيْمٍ ۝٥٨
ayahs.tr: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ اَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.tr: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمْ اَعْهَدْ اِلَيْكُمْ يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ اَنْ لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطٰنَۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٦٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنِ اعْبُدُوْنِيْؕؔ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ ۝٦١
ayahs.tr: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيْرًاؕ اَفَلَمْ تَكُوْنُوْا تَعْقِلُوْنَ ۝٦٢
ayahs.tr: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

ayahs.ar: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.tr: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

ayahs.ar: اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.tr: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلٰٓي اَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا͏ٓ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ اَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.tr: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَا࢜ءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلٰٓي اَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰي يُبْصِرُوْنَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.tr: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَا࢜ءُ لَمَسَخْنٰهُمْ عَلٰي مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۝٦٧ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِؕ اَفَلَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.tr: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنٰهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢ͏ْبَغِيْ لَهٗؕ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَّقُرْاٰنٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٦٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

ayahs.ar: لِّيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَي الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.tr: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ اَيْدِيْنَا͏ٓ اَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مٰلِكُوْنَ ۝٧١
ayahs.tr: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

ayahs.ar: وَذَلَّلْنٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوْبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَاْكُلُوْنَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.tr: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيْهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُؕ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.tr: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۝٧٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ نَصْرَهُمْۙ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّحْضَرُوْنَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.tr: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْۘ اِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ ۝٧٦
ayahs.tr: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيْمٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٧٧
ayahs.tr: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّنَسِيَ خَلْقَهٗؕ قَالَ مَنْ يُّحْيِ الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ ۝٧٨
ayahs.tr: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيْهَا الَّذِيْٓ اَنْشَاَهَا͏ٓ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيْمُ ۝٧٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

ayahs.ar: اࣙلَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْاَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ مِّنْهُ تُوْقِدُوْنَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.tr: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْؕؔ بَلٰيࣗ وَهُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۝٨١
ayahs.tr: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَمْرُهٗٓ اِذَا͏ٓ اَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا اَنْ يَّقُوْلَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ۝٨٢
ayahs.tr: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: فَسُبْحٰنَ الَّذِيْ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ۝٨٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
